E5_domain_restriction_unassociated_liqui.deployable_domain_rule: Apply the recalibrated Eyring law only to solvents whose SMILES contains no hydrogen-bond-donor hydroxyl group. This is evaluable from structure alone.
E5_domain_restriction_unassociated_liqui.domain_rule: Glasstone/Laidler/Eyring (1941) restrict dE_vis = dE_vap/2.45 to UNASSOCIATED liquids; hydrogen-bonded liquids are outside the stated domain. Stratification is theory-prescribed, not post hoc.
E5_domain_restriction_unassociated_liqui.margin_caveat: The 25% acceptance threshold was fixed before the stratified numbers were computed (it is the same threshold pre-registered for E4). TIER_B non-associating clears it by a narrow margin on n=9, so the CORROBORATED verdict is provisional and would not survive a materially stricter bar.

pre_exponential_separation.honesty_caveat: This ratio consumes A_fit and therefore the target solvent's OWN measured viscosity. It is a POST HOC physical corroboration that association marks a real discontinuity in Eyring's flow-unit assumption -- it is NOT itself a deployable a-priori applicability screen. The deployable screen is the purely STRUCTURAL rule (hydroxyl / hydrogen-bond-donor present in the SMILES), which requires no measurement; the ratio result is evidence that that structural rule tracks the physics rather than being arbitrary.

closes: Closes CIRCULARITY_REMAINS from the signed vft-arrhenius-adequacy-v1 gap ledger: supplies a prediction of pure-solvent viscosity in the coating window that consumes ZERO viscosity information about the solvent being scored, in a fully structure-only (SMILES-in) tier.
Quantifies separately, for the coating solvent panel, the two structural claims of Eyring absolute-rate theory (pre-exponential N_A.h/V_m; energy ratio dE_vap/2.45) rather than only their composite.

Establishes the accuracy cost of removing circularity: the gap between a transferable 2-constant panel-level law scored leave-one-solvent-out and the incumbent's 2-parameters-per-solvent in-sample ceiling.
does_not_close: Does NOT propose replacing the incumbent Arrhenius KPI for solvents that HAVE measured viscosity; where the datum exists the fitted law is strictly better. The a-priori law's role is scoring UNMEASURED candidate solvents.

dHvap is used at the normal boiling point (Tb); no Watson correction to the 298-333 K coating window was applied (that needs a critical temperature the portfolio has not yet locked). The correction would RAISE dE_vap, so the reported activation energies are a lower bound on the corrected value.

Structure-only sub-panel is n=13 (water and glycerol carry no molar-volume entry; 10 further solvents carry no locked dHvap), so family-conditional claims are underpowered; no conformal interval is claimed here.
Does NOT extend beyond pure Newtonian solvents to formulation blends (Grunberg-Nissan), pigment crowding (Krieger-Dougherty), or Krebs KU + sag, which remain Phase-1 wet-lab.
Does NOT edit the signed Arrhenius KPI, does NOT touch the 66-receipt master manifest, does NOT promote the module out of PRE_PHASE_0 (human dual-identity ceremony keys).
primary_references: Glasstone, S., Laidler, K.J. & Eyring, H. (1941) The Theory of Rate Processes, McGraw-Hill, ch. IX (dE_vis = dE_vap/2.45).
Fedors, R.F. (1974) Polym. Eng. Sci. 14(2):147-154, doi:10.1002/pen.760140211 (molar volume group contributions).
Joback, K.G. & Reid, R.C. (1987) Chem. Eng. Commun. 57:233-243, doi:10.1080/00986448708960487 (dHvap group contributions).
Arrhenius, S. (1889) Z. Phys. Chem. 4:226-248; Andrade, E.N. da C. (1930) Nature 125:309-310 (incumbent viscosity-temperature law).
purpose: Supply the first NON-CIRCULAR (zero-viscosity-information) prediction of pure-solvent Newtonian viscosity in the 25-60 C coating window, closing the CIRCULARITY_REMAINS gap logged by the module's signed vft-arrhenius-adequacy-v1 receipt, via Eyring absolute-rate theory chained to already-signed portfolio group-contribution baselines (Fedors molar volume, Joback dHvap).

redteam_observation_signed_kpi_ea_not_re.finding: The signed Phase-0 KPI's recorded fitted_activation_energy_j_mol is NOT reproducible by ordinary least squares on the four published viscosities recorded in the same file, for any temperature subset tried (all four; the 25/40/60 C training subset; 25/60 C endpoints).
redteam_observation_signed_kpi_ea_not_re.impact_on_this_audit: NONE for E1/E3/E4/E5, which use this audit's own transparent OLS refit throughout. E2 additionally reports the empirical Eyring denominator recomputed against the KPI-recorded Ea as a sensitivity.
redteam_observation_signed_kpi_ea_not_re.severity: ADVISORY -- logged for the module owner; not a claim of error, and not repaired here (the signed KPI is read-only to this audit).
redteam_observation_signed_kpi_ea_not_re.verified_consistent_part: the KPI's recorded predicted_viscosity_mpas values ARE reproduced exactly by anchoring at the 25 C reference viscosity and applying the recorded Ea, so the KPI is internally self-consistent; only the provenance of the Ea VALUE is unexplained.

theory.composite_E3: E1 and E2 imposed together -> zero free parameters
theory.non_circularity: No parameter used to score a solvent is fitted to that solvent's viscosity. E1/E2/E3 fit nothing at all. E4 fits 2 panel-level constants on the other 12 solvents only. The incumbent Arrhenius KPI spends 2 parameters PER solvent, both fitted to the target's own viscosity, so its in-sample MAPE is an upper bound on achievable accuracy, not a peer comparison -- it is reported as the generous reference ceiling.
theory.tier_a: V_m from experimental density; dHvap experimental (NIST/Majer-Svoboda)
theory.tier_b: V_m from Fedors 1974 groups; dHvap from Joback-Reid 1987 groups; SMILES-only, consumes NO measured property of the target solvent
theory.transferable_E4: eta = k.(N_A.h/V_m).exp(c.dE_vap/(R.T)); k and c fitted ONCE per panel, leave-one-SOLVENT-out
